$comment: agents-mcp machine requirements. Single owner of this table: src/server.ts --doctor renders CLI presence live, and ../install.sh reads the same file with jq for `list`. Nothing here installs anything. Every CLI is optional on its own: the matching agent is simply unavailable and agents_status reports it; routing degrades to the configured fallback. TYPESAFE_API_KEY is an env requirement, not a binary.

binaries.what: the Claude Code CLI the claude adapter spawns
the Codex CLI the codex adapter spawns
binaries.install: brew install codex  # then: codex login

binaries.what: the Antigravity CLI the agy adapter spawns (the default routing fallback)
binaries.install: install the Antigravity CLI from https://antigravity.google

env.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
env.what: enables the Jev classifier for agent_call{agent:"auto"}; without it auto routing always uses the fallback agent
